scope: Checklist of major UK national daily/Sunday titles and representative leading Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, London, and English regional publishers. BBC is shown only as a separate news-site comparator, not a newspaper. This is not a complete inventory of every UK newspaper or regional title.
method: New website families only: one ordinary public homepage fetch each; metadata/counts only; at most one real linked headline URL observed, no article-body fetch where the current reader has no publisher profile. No cookies, browser, challenge bypass, provider calls, or denied-homepage retries. Existing 12-publisher audit evidence is reused as comparator and was not re-fetched.
editionNotes: Shared-site daily and Sunday mastheads are listed separately; a homepage URL/headline observation does not verify a Sunday edition article.
For shared-site editions without their own tested route, the route is identified as shared/unchecked.
The current list is intentionally open: local, specialist, language, trade, and other regional papers remain outside this bounded coverage pass.
